title: Recipe L: light augmentation, rotation +-180
hypothesis: Lighter camera-style augmentation may generalise better than synthetic corruption.
findings: Light augmentation is far worse (0.399 OOF): heavy corruption is needed for this data.
limitations: Single configuration; other light settings were not tried.
